verdict.rationale: An in-product AI assistant that surfaces insights from project data is a plausible capability for a backend platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: vector storage and similarity search, image-labeling and AI app-building via Functions. It also shows an MCP server that lets external LLM clients operate on the project. None of this is a documented in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data.
